|descr= Returns whether one value is '''not''' equal to another. String comparison is case-'''in'''sensitive (e.g <sqf inline>"STRINGtext" != "stringTEXT" // returns false - strings are equivalent</sqf>).
{{Feature|important|''a'' and ''b'' types '''must''' match: comparing e.g [[String]] with [[Number]] is invalid.}}

|s1= a [[a != b|!=]] b

|p1= a:

|p2= b: identical to ''a''<nowiki/>'s type

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if ''a'' is different from ''b'', [[false]] otherwise

|x1= <sqf>

|x4= <sqf>if (alive _unit1 != alive _unit2) then { hint "One of the units is dead while another is alive" };</sqf>
